_purpose: Team-shared Claude Code settings. Committed to git so every developer gets the same permission allowlist, env vars, and hooks. Per-machine tweaks go in settings.local.json (gitignored).
_when_you_want_a_file_like_this: Any project using Claude Code with more than one developer. Even solo, committed permissions and hooks document what Claude is allowed to do in this repo.
_why_it_matters: Allowlist + denylist drastically cuts permission prompts during sessions without lowering safety.
Hooks are deterministic - they enforce things the LLM 'rules' would otherwise have to remember.
Env vars set here apply to every Claude Code session in this repo - no per-developer setup.
_what_goes_in_it: permissions.allow - tools and bash patterns auto-approved without a prompt.
permissions.deny  - tools and bash patterns rejected outright (deny wins).
env               - environment variables for every Claude Code session in this repo.
hooks.PreToolUse  - scripts that gate tool calls before they run (e.g. validate-bash.sh).
hooks.PostToolUse - scripts that run after a tool call (e.g. format-python.sh).
